column.rationale: Retain the documented semantic contract and known table producer/consumer boundary; no contradictory ownership, duplication, or recovery evidence was found.

index.rationale: Retain the named index because its leading columns support a current filter, join, or ordering path and no covering autoindex proves it redundant.

physical_relation.rationale: Retain the physical relation because it enforces the documented ownership and deletion contract for current databases.

application_relation.rationale: Retain the application relation because polymorphic, projection, snapshot, or source-path identity intentionally cannot use one ordinary SQLite foreign key and current producers apply its lifecycle rule.

sources.rationale: Required stable parent registry for every imported source domain; scan producers and cross-domain consumers depend on its IDs and kind uniqueness.

source_files.rationale: Required rebuildable fingerprint and retry ledger; it separates scan state from normalized descendants and drives idempotent ingestion.

workspaces.rationale: Required stable Project identity and current browse target; SET NULL children and polymorphic links preserve user organization when discovery changes.

sessions.rationale: Required normalized Session identity, parent hierarchy, activity boundary, retrieval source, and Usage Record parent under approved PRD-0002 contracts.

activity_events.rationale: The normalized event table remains required; FEAT-0032 removed its unused generic metadata slot after an all-null runtime preflight while preserving event identity, content, provenance, and ordering.

usage_price_snapshots.rationale: Required immutable price provenance cited by Usage Records; RESTRICT deletion protects historical calculation evidence.

usage_model_prices.rationale: Required versioned Decimal price inputs, including approved long-context tiers, under passed PRD-0004.

usage_records.rationale: The Usage Record table and frozen attribution remain required; FEAT-0031 restores the three-value compatible CHECK through backup-backed exact-value preservation without absorbing deferred timestamp metadata.

context_roots.rationale: Required non-rebuildable user source registration and enablement boundary; normalized documents cannot reconstruct this selection intent.

context_documents.rationale: The rebuildable corpus remains required and FEAT-0030 added the source and Project lookup indexes selected by the current query prefixes.

workstreams.rationale: Required top-level user-curated organization and physical parent; scans cannot recover its identity, wording, or grouping intent.

threads.rationale: Required ordered non-rebuildable work subdivision with current goals and resource ownership.

workstream_links.rationale: Required reviewed heterogeneous Workstream membership; application validation and historical unresolved-target behavior are intentional.

thread_links.rationale: Required reviewed heterogeneous Thread membership; inference cannot reproduce accepted scope and provenance.

local_resources.rationale: The curated resource table remains required; FEAT-0030 removed its redundant named path index while preserving the UNIQUE(path) autoindex.

external_resources.rationale: Required curated external-reference identity; URL uniqueness, title, provenance, and memberships are not source-rebuildable.

suggestions.rationale: Required generated review queue and accepted/rejected history; refresh semantics explicitly preserve protected decisions.

checkpoints.rationale: Confirmed snapshots remain non-rebuildable; FEAT-0030 added the Workstream/version index without transforming any snapshot row.

checkpoint_resource_refs.rationale: Historical resource snapshots remain required; FEAT-0030 removed the redundant named index while preserving the four-column UNIQUE autoindex.

maintenance_runs.rationale: Operational history and artifact correlation remain required; FEAT-0037 gives compatible databases the same optional Workstream SET NULL relation through a backup-backed, exact-value-preserving repair.

search_index.rationale: Required fully derived FTS projection; explicit lifecycle deletion and full rescan recovery make its application relations appropriate.

checkpoints.based_on_activity_at.rationale: This boundary can originate from mixed cross-domain activity formats and is semantically part of the confirmed snapshot.

sessions.index_policy.rationale: FEAT-0035 enforces the approved full/metadata_only vocabulary in fresh and compatible databases after invalid-value preflight and exact backup-backed row preservation.

thread_links.entity_type.rationale: Application validation uses a five-type set, while a constraint needs an approved extensibility path for future resources.

canonical-timestamp-contract.blocker: No durable choice yet defines canonical UTC storage, accepted legacy parser inputs, precision, timezone rendering, and preservation of mixed SQLite/source/Python timestamp text.

closed-vocabulary-constraints.blocker: Application constants and state transitions exist, but extensibility, invalid legacy-row handling, FTS enforcement, and safe rebuild sequencing are not approved as one durable vocabulary contract.
